test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six sisters Hina, Ishita, Jena, Kamla, Lalita, Meena are sitting in two rows. Three of them face north and the other three face south. Sisters sitting in the same row face the same direction. Meena is facing south and is not sitting in the corner. Lalita is facing Hina who is sitting to the right of Meena. Ishita is to the immediate right of Jena. Who sits opposite Ishita?
solution:
The sitting arrangement as per the given information:

1. Meena is facing south and is not sitting
 in the corner.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97948d7487561979109e5a7638ed1f3ad7d8279f8a4c5f96f537569245630808.png] 

2. Lalita is facing Hina who is sitting to the right of Meena.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/118e76224441b12d09cd92a199ea6d5a26295908799fec00c54d204654b1c6b5.png] 

3. Ishita is to the immediate right of Jena.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd874d55819072e5c8c0cb628a17dda64cbaa44110edd95c1a83bb8d78e7d9d2.png] 

Here, **'Kamla'** is sitting opposite Ishita.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
